technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Current technology in Japan

# Included processes
This module includes the material and energy efforts as well as the related emissions (air/water) and waste amounts for the production of polarizer, liquid crystals as well as the patternin of color filters on the LCD panel. Estimations for infrastructure and transport of the raw materials are included as well.
